title: HearSay Benchmark: Do Audio LLMs Leak What They Hear?

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the Blind Bias Rate (BBR) by querying models with empty audio inputs to quantify their intrinsic statistical priors and tendency to hallucinate gender attributes, compared against their Inference Accuracy Rate (IAR) on actual voiceprints.
